map.沉降速度 v = d²·g·(ρ_p − ρ_f)/(18·η)（d 粒径、ρ_: Settling velocity v = d²·g·(ρ_p − ρ_f)/(18·η), where d is the particle size, ρ_p and ρ_f the particle and liquid densities and η the viscosity; valid for Re < 0.2.
